system.description:
You play a demonic sound, creating a dark hellscape where only pain and suffering exist for all those under the effects of this genjutsu. All creatures within range must make a Wisdom save.

Critical Success: Affected creatures takes half of 10d8 psychic damage and suffer no further effects.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 10d8 psychic damage and is Blinded until the end of their next turn as they only see a hellscape until then.

Failure: Affected creatures take 10d8 Psychic damage at the beginning of their turns, is Restrained in place as threads wrap around them and gain 3 ranks of Disoriented. Affected creatures remake their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this jutsu’s effects on them on a success.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but affected creatures begin to see themselves dissolve into the pits of hell. Roll 1d4 at the beginning of the affected creatures turn. They also suffer the listed effect based on the result.

1: They spend their Action on their turn screaming for aid from their allies as their mind fractures.

2: They gain a rank of Weakened as they can feel their body give way to the madness of this jutsu.

3: They take Chakra damage equal to the psychic damage they took as a result of this jutsu as their chakra network is under immense stress.

4: They gain 1 rank of Concussed as the mental strain becomes too much for them.

Doki (Bandaged)

Large Mutant

Armor Class 16 + 1 at 7th and 15th levels.

Hit Points 20 + (Your Level)

Speed 50 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +3 | + | CON | +4 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +5 | + | INT | -2 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Condition Immunities All Mental, Exhaustion

Saving Throws Dex, Con

Skills Athletics, Acrobatics, Perception (Mastery 2)

Senses Blindsight 30 ft.

Demonic Immunity. Doki are immune to negative effects and damage inflicted by jutsu cast with the Auditory Ninja Tool.

Shared Proficiency. The Doki’s proficiency bonus is equal to yours and uses it calculate its saving throws and it uses its summoners highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for its calculations.

Attacks

Multiattack. Doki (Bandaged) can make 2 attacks with Revolt of the Demon World.

Revolt of the Demon World. Ranged Genjutsu Attack: +Your attack bonus to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 2d8 Psychic damage, and half as much chakra damage. This increases by +1d8 at 7th and 15th levels.

Cursed Veil. The Bandaged Doki radiates a distorting aura of illusory chakra that warps the perceptions of nearby creatures. The first time a Hostile creatures moves or begins their turn within 10 feet of the Bandaged Doki, they must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure their AC and jutsu save DC is reduced by 2 and they cannot benefit from advantage on saving throws until the start of their next turn as the curse briefly unravels their mental defenses.

Doki (Club)

Large Mutant

Armor Class 16 + 3 at 7th and 15th levels.

Hit Points 20 + (Three times your level)

Speed 30 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +4 | + | CON | +5 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +3 | + | INT | -2 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Condition Immunities All Mental, Exhaustion

Saving Throws Str, Con

Skills Athletics (Mastery 2), Acrobatics, Perception

Senses Blindsight 30 ft.

Demonic Immunity. Doki are immune to negative effects and damage inflicted by jutsu cast with the Auditory Ninja Tool.

Shared Proficiency. The Doki’s proficiency bonus is equal to yours and uses it calculate its saving throws and it uses its summoners highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for its calculations.

Stalwart Interception. Whenever an allied creature within 10 feet of this Doki would take damage from an attack, it can spend its Reaction to interpose. The Doki (Club) becomes the new target and takes the full damage instead.

Durable Demon. The Doki (Club) reduces all damage it takes from area of effect attacks by an amount equal to its summoners level.

Attacks

Club. Melee Weapon Attack: Your attack bonus to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d10+4 Bludgeoning damage.

Earthshaker Slam (Recharge 5-6). The Doki slams their hammer into the ground, all hostile creatures within 10 feet of it, must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 2d8 + 4 bludgeoning damage (+1d8 at 7th and 15th levels.) and their speed is reduced by 20 feet until the end of their next turn and are knocked Prone. While their speed is reduced in this way, they cannot benefit from bonuses to movement.

Revolt of the Demon World. Ranged Genjutsu Attack: +Your attack bonus to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 Psychic damage, and half as much chakra damage. This increases by +1d8 at 7th and 15th levels.

Doki (Claw)

Large Mutant

Armor Class 16 + 2 at 7th and 15th levels.

Hit Points 20 + (Twice your Level)

Speed 40 ft.

| | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save | | Mod | Save |

| STR | +4 | + | CON | +3 | + | WIS | +0 | + |

| DEX | +4 | + | INT | -2 | + | CHA | +0 | + |

Condition Immunities All Mental, Exhaustion

Saving Throws Str, Dex

Skills Athletics, Acrobatics (Mastery 2), Perception

Senses Blindsight 30 ft.

Demonic Immunity. Doki are immune to negative effects and damage inflicted by jutsu cast with the Auditory Ninja Tool.

Shared Proficiency. The Doki’s proficiency bonus is equal to yours and uses it calculate its saving throws and it uses its summoners highest jutsu attack bonus or save DC for its calculations.

Predatory Endurance. At the start of its summoners turns, if an allied Doki creature within 30 feet took damage since the summoners previous turn, All Doki creatures gains 10 temporary hit points. This increases by +5 at 7th and 15th levels.

Attacks

Multiattack. Doki (Claw) can make 2 attacks with Claw.

Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +Your attack bonus to h it, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6+4 Slashing damage. This attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 19-20. If you score at least one attack, you force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Disorient.

Revolt of the Demon World. Ranged Genjutsu Attack: +Your attack bonus to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 3d8 Psychic damage, and half as much chakra damage. This increases by +1d8 at 7th and 15th levels.
